response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile software craftsman with strong full-stack, distributed systems, and DevOps exposure, but he does not meet the core minimum qualifications for this role: he lacks the required 8 years of C++ programming experience (only brief C/C++ work at National Instruments and a bachelor's thesis project), has no demonstrated large-scale cloud compute platform leadership, and no explicit experience mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers in a formal technical leadership capacity.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse software engineering experience across web, mobile, embedded, and distributed systems
Demonstrated technical leadership through talks, workshops, open-source projects, and mentoring (Refactoring Dojos, Selenium courses)
Experience with distributed/high-throughput systems (Sociomantic microservices handling millions of requests/sec) and DevOps infrastructure (CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes)
concerns: Minimal C++ experience (~6 months at National Instruments plus a student project) versus the required 8 years
No direct experience owning or leading an internal cloud compute platform's technical strategy
Career trajectory is broad generalist/full-stack rather than deep infrastructure/compute specialist, with no formal 'technical lead' title mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers

key_factors.factor: No cloud compute platform leadership experience
Strong distributed systems and mentoring background
